data_product_description: This dashboard shows prescribing linked to national drug alerts and safety reviews. It helps authorised users spot potential risks and unwarranted variation in prescribing across England.
data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard

Prescribing safety is a key priority for the NHS, as inappropriate or high-risk prescribing can lead to avoidable harm, hospital admissions, and increased healthcare costs. The Alerts report contains data on prescribing that has been specifically highlighted as part of a national drug alert or safety review.

This report provides authorised users with interactive reports that identify potential safety concerns, such as prescribing of medicines associated with increased risk or deviations from national guidance. These alerts help SICBLs and local health economies to monitor prescribing behaviour and take timely action where necessary. 

This report also highlights areas of potential concern across England so that SICBLs and local health economies can determine whether the variation is warranted or unwarranted and consider appropriate interventions. While the report provides valuable insights, it is not intended to be used in isolation. Its purpose is to generate discussion and inform local strategies for improving prescribing safety and quality.

By identifying unwarranted variation and potential risks, the Alerts report can help reduce harm, improve patient outcomes, and support compliance with national standards. It may also help identify examples of best practice that others can learn from.

There are 3 metrics for this data:

**30 January 2020:** A comparator for unique patients under 12 years old prescribed Domperidone has been released in response to the following alert: [MHRA Drug Alert](https://www.gov.uk/drug-safety-update/domperidone-for-nausea-and-vomiting-lack-of-efficacy-in-children-reminder-of-contraindications-in-adults-and-adolescents)

**02 December 2019:** A comparator for co-prescribing of oxycodone and amitriptyline has been released in response to the following report: [Regulation 28 Report to Prevent Future Deaths](https://www.judiciary.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/Graham-Saffery-2019-0301_Redacted.pdf)

**20 November 2023:** A comparator for co-prescribing of warfarin and tramadol has been released in response to the following report: [Susan Gladstone: Prevention of future deaths report - Courts and Tribunals Judiciary](https://www.judiciary.uk/prevention-of-future-death-reports/susan-gladstone-prevention-of-future-deaths-report/#related_content)
